subject: planner: fix the wrong join estimation depending on missing or uninitialized stats (#61604)
summary: Planner-only change: `getGroupNDVs` now requires `idx.IsEssentialStatsLoaded()` before using composite-index `idx.NDV`, preventing pseudo/uninitialized index stats (often `NDV=0`) from collapsing multi-column NDV to 1 and severely underestimating GROUP BY / join cardinalities; upstream/master still keeps the same guard.
